### P1 — Must Have
- [x] T008 [US1] [US2] [FR-002] [FR-003] [FR-004] [FR-005] Add three functions to `hooks/ledger-automerge.sh`, after `verified_head_set`:
  - `am_is_launcher()` returns true when `HEFESTO_LAUNCHER=1` and `CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID` is unset. `verified_head_set` (`:46`) now calls it.
  - `item_kind_signer` prints `launcher`, the `--by` name, or nothing. It runs `am_not_worker` whenever the launcher marker or a signature is present. A signature means `REVIEWED=1` and an `RBY` that matches `AM_NAME_RE`; half a signature dies.

Signed or launcher calls set both fields and append an `item-kind-changed` event when either field changes. Unsigned calls set `item_kind` only.
